component.name: schneidi
component.summary: Fast, light video editor that an AI assistant can edit with

description.p: schneidi is a fast, light video editor. It starts in under a second, plays a demanding 1080p60 project smoothly on four CPU cores and runs even on a Raspberry Pi. It has four pages for the steps of an edit – Media, Edit, Color and Deliver – and an AI assistant can edit together with you, live in the project you have open.

Tell the AI chat next to the timeline what you want (Claude, an OpenAI-compatible service or a local model through Ollama), or let an assistant work through the command line and its MCP server. It finds pauses, scene changes, loud moments and the beats of a song, transcribes, cuts, grades, mixes and renders – and every change is shown and is one undo step.

ul.li: Multiple video and audio tracks with ripple, roll, slip and slide trims, compound clips and multicam
9:16 shorts next to the 16:9 edit in the same project, with auto reframe and word-by-word captions
Templates with placeholders and a brand kit: many videos from one template and a table
Color wheels, windows, LUTs and scopes
Titles, subtitles, transitions, loudness normalization and voice cleaning
Offline speech recognition, text-based editing and sync of several recordings by their sound
Render presets for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok
User interface in English, German, Spanish, French, Polish and Russian

description.p: Everything stays on your computer: no account, no cloud, no telemetry. The only request schneidi makes by itself is a check for a new release, at most once a day, which can be turned off.

screenshot.caption: The Edit page with an AI assistant connected: transcript, title inspector and timeline
The same edit as a 9:16 short: reframed picture and word-by-word captions
The AI chat next to the timeline lists every step it takes
The Color page: color wheels, a window and the RGB parade
Multicam: several angles of one event side by side
The Deliver page: render presets and render queue

description.p: Languages Update: ten more UI languages (Ukrainian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Italian, Hindi, Dutch, Turkish, Korean, Indonesian), x264/x265 in the downloads, a selectable proxy size, placing only picture or only sound, drop-frame timecode, a smoother and faster start, and a big round of fixes.

Newcomer Update: in-app tours on a built-in practice project (first steps, editing, color, compositing, task guides), hide pages you don't use, the preview on a second monitor with a chosen resolution, key sets for Premiere Pro and Final Cut Pro (with .kys import and a key trainer), clips tilted in 3D, voice-over straight onto a track with a live take in the timeline, draggable In/Out range with loop playback, proxies easier to make and see, and a much faster start.
Bug fix release: switching the large viewer off brings back the panel sizes exactly again; the mixer beside the timeline came back a few pixels narrower each time.

Compositing Update: a new Comp page with a layer view and a node canvas, masks (shapes, curves, gradients), green screen and luma keying, AI cutout of people (extension), tracking of points and faces, title looks with gradients, textures, edges, shadows and glow, real 3D text, ready-made recipes, and own effects as FFmpeg filter chains or shaders (shared code only runs after you allow it). An AI can build all of it through the CLI.

Bug fix release: cut-off recordings without a length get their full length, 4K exports keep their quality on PCs with little free memory, an AI can still read while a dialog is open in the app, the brand kit dialog no longer overwrites changes made meanwhile, and project files with broken characters say so when opened.

Template Update: reusable templates with placeholders that are filled by drag and drop or by an AI, many videos from one template and a table (CSV), a brand kit with colours, fonts, logo, intro and outro, five built-in templates and an Edit look. Renders pick fewer threads by themselves when memory is short.
Bug fix release: the highlight search for CS2 recordings now finds the player's kills by the frame of their kill feed lines, so red parts of the game picture are no longer taken for kills.

AI Director Update: a searchable index of every shot with its quality, speech and sound, an edit laid out as a story with a cut plan shown before anything changes, review renders, J/L cuts and room tone, songs cut to length on their phrases, and a collection of effect sounds.

Shorts Update: a format per timeline, so a 9:16 short lives next to the 16:9 edit; auto reframe, word-by-word captions, presets for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok, voice-over recording, voice cleaning and text to speech.

Speed Update: an own picture engine draws preview, stills and export the same way and uses the graphics card where there is one; faster exports with a fraction of the memory, faster start and seeking.
